title: Hide a Card Number
statement:
Receipts show only the end of a card number. Hide every digit except the last 4.

The input is one line with a card number made of at least one digit, with no spaces. Treat it as text, so leading zeros count as digits. Print a string of the same length where every digit except the last 4 is replaced by `*` and the last 4 digits stay as they are. When the number has 4 digits or fewer, nothing is hidden, so print it unchanged.

Input:

```text
4111222233334444
```

Expected output:

```text
************4444
```
hints: Work out how many digits to hide: the length minus 4, but never less than 0.
Build the answer from two parts: that many `*` characters, then the end of the original string.

python.solution:
def hide_card_number(card: str) -> str:
    hidden = max(len(card) - 4, 0)
    return "*" * hidden + card[hidden:]


card = input().strip()
print(hide_card_number(card))
